units.passage: Describing how the use of AI tools will be interpreted with respect to the honor code; • Describing how, when, and in which instances students should disclose the use of AI tools on assignments; and • Describing how the use of AI tools will be enforced.
units.why: "Describing how the use of AI tools will be enforced" matches P123, saying how misuse will be detected and handled.

units.passage: Explain the consequences for the students if your expectations regarding the use of generative AI tools are not met.
units.why: "Explain the consequences for the students if your expectations regarding the use of generative AI tools are not met" asks instructors to say in advance how violations are handled; P123 fits better than P37 because no penalty is named.

units.passage: Faculty should p rovide clear expectations regarding academic integrity and AI. Clarify for students your expectations regarding using any generative AI tools or applications. State these expectations clearly on your course syllabus and in any assignment prompts. Explain the consequences for the students if your expectations regarding the use of generative AI tools are not met.
units.why: "Explain the consequences for the students if your expectations ... are not met" asks instructors to state consequences in advance, P123.

Under the tile "Enforce Your Course's AI Policy": "Respond appropriately if questions arise." It tells instructors to respond to questions about AI use in their course, which is the enforcement step (when-misuse, should). P123 (say how misuse will be handled) is the nearest type; it fits only partly because no detection or handling method is given.
units.fit_note: Only says to respond appropriately when questions about AI use arise; no detection or handling method is stated.

units.passage: If instructors use GenAI detection tools in a course, they should disclose to students when and how the software will be used.
units.why: "If instructors use GenAI detection tools in a course, they should disclose to students when and how the software will be used" requires telling students about detector use; P123 (say how misuse will be detected) fits best.
units.fit_note: Applies only if instructors use detectors; about disclosing detector use.

units.passage: It’s important to outline what constitutes AI misuse in your course and to make clear the consequences of crossing those boundaries.
units.why: 'outline what constitutes AI misuse in your course and ... make clear the consequences' asks instructors to say how misuse is defined and handled, P123.

units.passage: Decide how you will be evaluating AI use, and share with your students.
units.why: 'Decide how you will be evaluating AI use, and share with your students': saying in advance how misuse will be handled (P123).

units.passage: A brief explanation of the honor system process is encouraged.
units.why: 'How will you proceed if you have concerns about AI use on an assignment? A brief explanation of the honor system process is encouraged.' asks instructors to state next steps (P123).
